intro: Oil and gas have made Brunei one of the richest countries in Asia per person.

chapters.title: Oil and gas
text: Most exports and government income come from oil and liquefied gas, much of it sold to Japan.
Brunei is building a petrochemical industry and promoting tourism to diversify.

chapters.title: Planning ahead
text: The 'Wawasan 2035' plan aims to make the economy less dependent on oil.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Brunei makes and sells to the world.
